postings.description:

Patria on kansainvälinen puolustusteollisuus- ja teknologiayhtiö, jolla on yli 100 vuoden kokemus alalta. Patrian huippuluokan osaajien ja Protected Mobility, Defence and Weapon Systems ja Sustainment Solutions -liiketoiminta-alueiden avulla varmistamme asiakkaillemme luotettavan toiminnan ja olemme kumppanina kriittisissä toiminnoissa maalla, merellä ja ilmassa – kun kaiken on pakko toimia. Patrian toimintamaita ovat Suomi, Ruotsi, Norja, Latvia, Belgia, Alankomaat, Saksa, Puola, Slovakia ja Japani. Lue lisää www.patriagroup.com.

Sustainment Solutions liiketoiminta-alue vastaa muun muassa elinkaarituen ja ohjelmistotuotteiden myynnistä, tarjonnasta ja toimituksista. Liiketoiminta-alue vastaa myös strategisesta kumppanuudesta Suomen puolustusvoimien ja Patrian viranomaisliiketoiminnan kanssa.

Haemme nyt Jämsän Halliin henkilöitä nimikkeellä

autoklaavioperaattori

Tehtävänkuvaus

Autoklaavioperaattorina tehtävänäsi on laminoitujen osien kuljettaminen trukilla autoklaaville, lastaus ja kovettaminen autoklaavissa ja siihen liittyen autoklaaviprosessin valvominen. Autoklaavauksen jälkeen irrotat kovetetut laminoidut osat muoteista ja teet irrotusainekäsittelyn muoteille. Kuljetat myös tyhjät muotit laminointiin tarpeen mukaan. Lisäksi teet ennakkohuoltoja, huollat muotteja ja suunnittelet autoklaaviajot yhdessä toisen vuoron kanssa.

Tulet työskentelemään etenkin muiden autoklaavioperaattorien kanssa, jonka lisäksi teet yhteistyötä muun tuotannon, laadun sekä valmistussuunnittelun kanssa.

Tätä tehtävää hakiessa otathan huomioon sen, että tulemme todennäköisesti siirtymään 3-vuorotyöhön maanantai-perjantai välillä.

Vähintään välttävä englannin kielen kirjallinen osaaminen on tehtävässä tärkeää.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

- Olet suorittanut jonkin ammatillisen peruskoulutuksen, mutta etenkin prosessitekniikan ala tukee tehtävässä suoriutumista.

- Olet paineensietokykyinen, otat vastuun työstäsi ja osaat tarvittaessa priorisoida tehtäviäsi.

- IT-taitosi ovat sujuvat.

Mitä tarjoamme

Meillä Patriassa pääset tekemään sellaista, mitä muualla et pääse edes näkemään. Sinulla on mahdollisuus pitkään ja monipuoliseen työuraan Patrian ainutlaatuisten tuotteiden ja toimintojen parissa. Pääset mukaan osaksi hyvähenkistä kokeneista ammattilaista koostuvaa tiimiämme.

Tarjoamme sinulle henkilöstöetuna mm. vuosittaisen tulospalkkiomallin sekä lounas- ja virike-edun ja työhön liittyvän opiskelun tukemista. Meillä on kattavat työterveyspalvelut, joihin sisältyy esim. erikoislääkäripalvelut. Tarjoamme myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen työntekijöillemme.

Arvostamme myös vapaa-aikaasi, joten meillä pystyt tasapainottamaan työn ja vapaa-ajan joustavasti esimerkiksi hyödyntämällä liukuvaa työaikaa. Pääset tutustumaan tarkemmin patrialaisiin ja meillä työskentelyyn täältä.

Haluaisitko olla osa tarinaamme?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Haethan tehtävää 21.10.2026 mennessä. Huomiothan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

📧 ext-jenni.autio@patriagroup.com

Miksi Patria?

1. Turvaa yhteiskunnalle: edistämme ylpeydellä kansallista ja kansainvälistä turvallisuutta. Siihen tarvitaan vastuullista asennetta ja huippuosaamista, joka takaa toimintavarmuuden kaikissa olosuhteissa.

postings.title: Director, Operations (Germany)
postings.description:
Patria is a workplace where you build common security. At Patria, ordinary people solve extraordinary challenges. When it comes to critical operations on land, sea and air, expertise is vital. Quality is in people – in each and every one of us. You make the difference.

Patria is a trusted international provider of customer-centric defence, security and aviation life cycle support services and technology solutions with a strong growth strategy. For more information, please visit www.patriagroup.com.

Join Patria and Shape the Future of European Defence Mobility

Patria Protected Mobility is a leading European provider of armoured vehicle solutions, delivering advanced mobility capabilities to defence forces across Europe and beyond. Our portfolio includes the combat-proven Patria 6x6 and Patria AMV XP platforms, responding to modern defence needs through innovation, reliability and close cooperation with customers and industry partners.

We are now expanding our operations across Europe, including in Germany, where we are supporting the Bundeswehr through the multinational CAVS programme and establishing local production capabilities in close cooperation with German industry partners.

The Patria 6x6 vehicle has been selected as the platform for the multinational CAVS (Common Armoured Vehicle System) programme, involving Finland, Latvia, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, Norway and the United Kingdom. Led by Finland, the programme aims to strengthen European defence capabilities and NATO cooperation. For more information, please visit https://www.patriagroup.com/about-us/research-and-innovations/common-armoured-vehicle-system-cavs-programme

We are looking for an experienced and driven

Director, Operations (Germany)

to manage production operations and industrial partnerships in support of the German CAVS programme.

In this strategic role, you will oversee vehicle production activities across multiple partner facilities in Germany and play a key role in establishing and scaling local manufacturing capabilities. Working at the intersection of production, sourcing, logistics, procurement and technology transfer, you will ensure successful programme execution and operational excellence.

The position takes place in Freisen, but some travelling inside Germany is required.

Your Responsibilities

As Director, Operations, you will monitor the performance of our partners in vehicle production operations across partner facilities in Germany and drive the successful ramp-up and implementation of the German CAVS programme.

You will coordinate activities between sourcing, procurement, logistics, technology transfer teams and production partners to ensure seamless execution across the value chain. You will also manage Patria’s supplier and partner network in Germany, ensuring effective collaboration, clear responsibilities and strong operational alignment across external production partners.

The role also includes developing and managing vendor and supplier partnerships that support production, industrialisation and business objectives, as well as representing supplier performance, production readiness and logistics topics in customer and stakeholder discussions.

You will be responsible for ensuring that delivery performance, production quality, operational efficiency and cost targets are consistently achieved. This includes aligning production capacity with programme requirements and future business growth, identifying operational risks, bottlenecks and investment needs, and driving corrective actions when needed.

What We Are Looking For

You have experience in complex manufacturing environments, and you understand production processes and supply chains. You thrive in dynamic growth situations, enjoy solving challenges and have a proven ability to build high-performing industrial operations through collaboration and leadership. You have excellent networking skills, and you can take ownership in even difficult situations where the solution isn’t always obvious.

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, or a related field.

- Proven experience in production operations within industrial manufacturing environments, as well as in managing industrial or delivery projects.

- Experience in the defence industry, automotive sector, heavy machinery manufacturing, industrial projects or a comparable field.

- Experience in production ramp-ups, industrial scaling, operational development and delivery project management.

- Strong understanding of supply chains, production management, logistics, and manufacturing processes.

- Ability to report on production progress, project deliverables, milestones, risks and performance against agreed targets.

- Familiarity of cooperating closely with internal stakeholders, customers, suppliers and industrial partners to ensure alignment and resolve operational issues.

- Experience in intercultural leadership and international collaboration.

- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.

- Willingness to travel within Germany and internationally.

Why Join Patria?

At Patria, you will have the opportunity to contribute to one of Europe’s most significant defence mobility programmes and play a key role in strengthening European defence capabilities. You will work in an international environment alongside experienced professionals and industry-leading partners, helping to build Germany’s future armoured vehicle production capabilities.

We offer you

At Patria, you can build a long and versatile career with our unique products and services. In this position, you will have a meaningful opportunity to contribute to Patria’s international growth and help shape our future direction.

Would you like to be part of our story?

Please submit your application through our recruitment system by 25.10.2026. We review applications during the application period and will proceed with selections as soon as suitable candidates are found. Please note that we do not process applications sent by email.

For further information, please contact our recruiter Sari Rantanen at ext-sari.rantanen@patriagroup.com

We process all candidate information confidentially. A security clearance and drug test will be conducted for the selected candidate.

postings.title: Solution Architect
postings.description:
Patria is a workplace where you build common security. At Patria, ordinary people solve extraordinary challenges. When it comes to critical operations on land, sea and air, expertise is vital. Quality is in people – in each and every one of us. You make the difference.

Patria is a modern and international defence and technology company with over 100 years of experience. Through our top-notch experts and Protected Mobility, Defence and Weapon Systems and Sustainment Solutions business areas, we ensure reliable operations for our customers and serve as a partner in critical functions on land, sea and air – when if is not an option. Patria’s operating countries include Finland, Sweden, Norway, Latvia, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, Poland, Slovakia and Japan. Read more www.patriagroup.com.

We are now searching for a

Solution Architect

to join our Enterprise Architecture team in Patria Group IT Team.

Your primary working location is Tampere, but Hämeenlinna, Helsinki, Espoo or Jämsä Halli can also be considered. In this role, you will have approximately 50 % on-site work requirements, and there is an average of 30 travel days per year, primarily domestic travel.

In this role, you will help shape business-critical solutions across a range of projects. You will drive the harmonization of business processes, IT capabilities, and architecture across the organization. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, project managers, architects, and a wide range of subject matter experts across IT, cybersecurity, information security, compliance, data, and AI.

As a Solution Architect, you will ensure that solution designs address business and IT requirements across applications, data, security, technology, and services, both within projects and as a foundation for future services. You will help guide projects from idea to implementation while maintaining alignment with Patria's architecture principles, target architecture, and long-term technology vision.

You will become part of an IT development community consisting of experienced in-house professionals and trusted external partners. This diverse network offers excellent opportunities to collaborate, learn, and contribute to a wide range of strategic business and technology initiatives.

Modern technologies, including AI, automation and cloud technologies, are an integral part of our development landscape. In this role, you will actively evaluate where AI and other modern technologies can create tangible business value and help deliver secure, practical, and future-ready solutions for Patria.

Key Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions.

- Design and develop scalable, high-performance architectures that meet business requirements.

- Lead the design work and implementation of solutions, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget.

- Provide guidance and mentorship to project and IT service and application teams.

- Evaluate and recommend new technologies and tools to enhance our solutions.

- Identify and assess suitable use cases for AI and modern technologies as part of solution planning and development.

- Work closely with business and process developers to identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to capitalize on them.

- Ensure that all solutions are aligned with the company's overall business strategy and goals.

What kind of person are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior professional who understands overall IT architecture and is eager to work closely with the business side. This role requires understanding in IT architecture across different architecture layers. We are not necessarily seeking a niche expert in one technical area, but rather a generalist who can independently connect business needs with practical, secure and scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in business development and a proven track record of designing and implementing innovative solutions that drive business growth.

Required Qualifications:

- Extensive experience in solution architecture and business development.

- Senior-level capability to work independently in a developing environment where operating models, methods and tools are continuously developing.

- Strong understanding of development / project methodologies and best practices.

- Understanding of multiregulated business environment.

- Excellent and independent problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Ability to communicate complex (technical) concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to understand business needs and discuss solution requirements effectively with business stakeholders.

- Excellent English skills, Fluent Finnish skills are a plus.

- Flexibility and a development-oriented mindset toward building ways of working.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher education in Computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Practical experience with IT infrastructure and information security.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to identify and capitalize on new opportunities.

If you are an innovative thinker who thrives in a collaborative environment and are passionate about driving business growth through cutting-edge technology solutions, we would love to hear from you!

We Offer you:

You will join our team at an exciting time in the company's history as we grow and internationalize, harmonizing and unifying our processes. We are building new production lines and developing new ways for production. You could be part of critical work to ensure societal safety.

- Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

- Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge projects with modern technologies such as AI and automation.

- Collaborative Team: Join a team of experienced and committed professionals who support and challenge each other.

- Close Business Collaboration: You will work closely with the business to drive impactful solutions.

- Impactful Projects: Contribute to significant projects that drive business transformation.

- Supportive Culture: A positive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and innovation.

- Leadership Opportunities: Lead projects and mentor other team members, shaping the future of our IT landscape.

We offer you personnel benefits, such as an annual performance bonus and vast employment benefits. We have a comprehensive occupational health, which includes e.g. specialists. We also offer free time accident insurance.

Would you like to be part of our story?

You can submit your application through our recruitment system. Please apply by 27.10.2026. Please note that we do not process applications sent by email.

For more information, please contact Marja Salminen, ext-marja.salminen@patriagroup.com.

We will process your information confidentially. A security clearance and a drug test will be conducted for the selected candidate.

Why work with us?

1. Securing society: We are proud to advance national and international security. It requires a responsible attitude and excellence that guarantees reliability in all conditions

2. You have an impact: At Patria, you have an impact in the content of your work, career development, your clients’ and the whole company's success. You can be as good as you can ever be.

3. Focus on the essential: Do what you love and see the results of your work. You are crucial to us. We want you to be well and live a full life.

4. A great bunch of people: We work in innovative and energetic teams where smiling is allowed. We believe that the best results are achieved in a good atmosphere.
